method: Static TypeScript AST traversal of inline scripts, JavaScript/TypeScript/Apps Script sources; lexical SQL declaration and literal action/RPC inventory. No application, browser or database execution.
limitations: callables tuples are [name, source line, suggested cluster]. Cluster routing uses name/file hints; reviewed module tables are authoritative for shared and ambiguous helpers.

Named locations include nested callbacks and bundled dependency helpers; counts are not counts of independent business features. Anonymous callbacks are represented by their enclosing source, not invented names.
SQL entries include historical definitions; later migrations may replace or revoke earlier contracts. Dynamic dispatch and dynamic SQL require the referenced source review.

All files under tests were read, including fixtures; the file manifest does not mean all tests were executed. Asset scope is top-level assets/*.js; shared modules/styles are cited separately in the reviewed map.
